contract: A and B variants share the same linguistic frame but differ in meaning-bearing facts.
No prefilled German answer or task-specific Russian translation; Russian only gives the role/goal for W.
Accept semantic equivalents and clarify ambiguity; spelling and inflection errors are nonblocking when meaning is clear.
Observe intended language coverage before administering: blocked items cannot be used as fair exams.
These cases are test definitions, not automated test results.
